listing.name: Prince of Persia (DOS) (SDLPoP)
listing.summary: Research listing. Upstream route: Native disassembly-derived port; official README links desktop builds externally. Limits: Review complete package contents and lawful original-data handling before managed admission. Upstream platforms: Official external desktop builds and documented Windows/Unix/macOS source compilation. Selected package CPU architectures unknown in frozen research. Original data: Original-data/package contract remains Unknown for this SDLPoP route: establish whether the selected distribution already includes necessary Prince of Persia DOS data and which original v1.0/modified DAT set is accepted. Retained README supports original/mod DAT files and MIDISND*.DAT music, but does not establish a separate player-owned executable/ROM requirement. Do not impose one without evidence; asset permission review remains separate. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
